name: Centurio
story: An elite Vulkan stationed at Aurora Temple and an old friend of Castor, whom he arrests on Cai's 15th birthday and imprisons beneath Dagsion. He joins in Part III after a rescue quest.

personalSkill.name: Sturdy Corundum
personalSkill.effect: Takes half damage in the first combat of each enemy phase.

joins: Part III: Salvation, Second Section, after completing the quest "Rescue Centurio".

build.notes: Sturdy Corundum halves the first enemy-phase combat. Joins after Rescue Centurio (Sec 2). Join class and level ?.

guide.role: Squad E wall: Sturdy Corundum halves the first enemy-phase hit
guide.summary: Squad E's choke. Sturdy Corundum halves the first combat each enemy phase and Castle Knight's Strike-Last Def +7 covers the rest. From Heavy B, Heavy Break+ doubles his counter damage on a Def/2 % roll.
guide.playstyle: Enemy phase: stand on the choke tile, Javelin in hand if archers or mages reach him, else the spear. Player phase: Defending Spear on what he can kill; Lend Defense on the next wall. Mov 4: he leads, never chases.
keys: Clear Rescue Centurio (Elissa Pass, 6 units) in Sec 2, then talk to him in Dagsion.
Arena Heavy every week from Sec 2: Spear A, Axe A and Heavy C/B in one course.
Take [[class:Castle Knight]] at Lv 45 in Sec 4: Def +13 flat, Def +30 growth.
Put him on the choke first each enemy phase: Corundum halves only the first combat.
Mage maps: Hexlock Shield on; Res 30 is his weak stat.
watch: Missable: Rescue Centurio is due 6/6; talk to him after (still possible in Sec 3).
Weight: Shielding Axe 12 + Hexlock 4 + Archer's Ring 3 = 19; armor, doubled anyway (Spd -6 flat). On offense the ring comes off first.
Doubled: Spd 40 growth, Castle Knight Spd -6 flat. Def carries him, not dodges.
Res: 30 growth, Castle Knight Res -2. Drake's mages are the threat.
Underworld Boon: spears and axes can't strip it; hold within 2 of Eshmel.
Join class, level and ranks ?: Castle Knight needs Axe A, Spear A, Heavy C at Lv 45.

decisions.topic: Go Castle Knight, not Great Knight
decisions.pick: Dreadnought, then Castle Knight in Sec 4
decisions.why: Castle Knight: Def +13 flat, Def +30 growth, Strike-Last Def +7, and stays armored for Heavy Break. Great Knight is cavalry (Breza, Hanno, Drake, Cohen & Maria punish it) and Def +15 growth.
decisions.else: Stay Dreadnought if Axe A or Spear A stalls

decisions.pick: Heavy Break+ (Heavy B) in the Castle Knight kit
decisions.why: x2 damage on a Def/2 % roll: at Def 50 that is about 25% of his counters. Castle Knight trains Heavy +4 a fight.
